title: K Program

phases.message: Learning weeks: light weights, focus on form

safety: Sharp or joint pain: stop that exercise
Muscle soreness for 1–2 days after a session is normal in the first weeks
First session: ask gym staff to show you how to set up the machines
Injury or health condition? Check with a doctor before starting
warmup: 10 min brisk incline walk or bike: breathing harder but still able to talk. Then 10 glute bridges + 10 bodyweight squats to wake up the glutes
cardio: Incline treadmill walk (incline 8–12%, 4.5–5.5 km/h), or stairmaster, or bike

week0.name: Cardio only
week0.message: Get used to the gym: easy pace, you can still talk

machines.name: Treadmill, incline walk
machines.tip: Stand tall and let go of the handrails; slow down if you can't talk
machines.alt: Exercise bike for the whole 30 min

machines.name: Exercise bike
machines.tip: Seat at hip height: the knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke

exercises.name: Hip thrust (machine, or Smith machine)
exercises.tip: Chin tucked, push through the heels, squeeze the glutes 1 s at the top
exercises.alt: Dumbbell glute bridge on the floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.tip: Soft knees, push the hips back, dumbbells slide down the thighs, back flat

exercises.name: Seated leg curl (machine)
exercises.tip: Control the weight on the way back (2–3 s)

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.tip: Hips square, kick back and slightly out, don't arch the lower back

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
exercises.tip: Lean slightly forward to feel it in the glutes

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.tip: Dumbbell held at the chest, sit down between the heels, knees follow the toes

exercises.name: Leg press, feet high and wide
exercises.tip: Feet high and wide works the glutes more; never lock the knees; lower back stays on the pad

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.tip: Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down toward the hips, chest up

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.tip: Sit tall, pull the handle to the belly, squeeze the shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.tip: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, don't let the hips sag

exercises.name: Hip thrust (machine, or Smith machine)
exercises.tip: Chin tucked, push through the heels, squeeze the glutes 1 s at the top
exercises.alt: Dumbbell glute bridge on the floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.tip: Step back, front knee over the middle of the foot, push through the front heel to stand
exercises.alt: Static split squat, holding something for balance
